passage.text: For this reason, over the last 20 years, there has been growing interest in developing psychological interventions for people who continue to experience psychotic symptoms despite receiving adequate pharmacological treatment. In early interventions for psychosis, psychotherapy may be a potentially relevant part of treatment, while medication alone might be neither sufficient nor effective.

source.title: Treatment-Resistant to Antipsychotics: A Resistance to Everything? Psychotherapy in Treatment-Resistant Schizophrenia and Nonaffective Psychosis: A 25-Year Systematic Review and Exploratory Meta-Analysis
source.authors: Polese, Daniela, Fornaro, Michele, Palermo, Mario et al.
